name: Vina Mazumdar
shortBio: Indian feminist sociologist and architect of Women’s Studies in India whose landmark Towards Equality report (1974) exposed how postcolonial modernization widened gender and class disparities.
centralQuestion: Why did formal constitutional equality in postcolonial India fail to prevent the structural marginalization of rural and working-class women?

keyWorks.title: Towards Equality: Report of the Committee on the Status of Women in India
keyWorks.description: Empirical sociological landmark demonstrating declining female labor participation and institutionalizing feminist policy research in India.

keyWorks.title: Memories of a Rolling Stone
keyWorks.description: Intellectual autobiography chronicling peasant women’s collective agency and the founding of Indian women’s studies.
